english.title: Knowingly made a false entry in a book / register / document kept / carried for purposes of Transport regulations
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) made an entry, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE ENTRY..), in a

(A)_[book]_
(B)_[register]_
(C)_[document]_

kept or carried for the purposes of regulations made under section 98 of the Transport Act 1968 which you knew to be false
english.legislation: Contrary to section 99(5) of the Transport Act 1968.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time Limit on Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
